raw:
The user wants UI strings for a Traditional Chinese app. The screen is a list page with pull-to-refresh functionality.

- s1: prompt text when pulling down (before release to refresh) — typically "下拉即可重新整理" or "下拉更新" — the hint shown while pulling down before triggering refresh. Common patterns: "下拉可以更新" / "放開立即更新" — but s1 specifically is "往下拉時的提示文字" = text shown when pulling down. Usually "下拉重新整理" or "下拉以更新".

- s2: status text after fetching completes — "更新完成" or "已更新" or "資料已更新".

- s3: empty list text — "目前沒有任何項目" or "清單目前沒有內容" / "這裡空空如也".

Output only a JSON object with keys s1, s2, s3, values strings, no other text. Use Traditional Chinese.

Let me write natural strings:
- s1: "下拉以更新內容" — hmm, when pulling down, common iOS style: "下拉以重新整理" then "放開以更新". Since only one string, "下拉即可更新資料" or "繼續下拉以更新". I'll pick "下拉以更新內容" or "下拉即可重新整理". Keep it simple: "下拉更新" is minimal. Maybe "下拉即可重新整理".

- s2: "資料已更新" — good.

- s3: "目前沒有任何資料" or "清單是空的" — friendly: "這裡還沒有任何項目". I'll use "目前沒有任何項目".

JSON only:
{"s1": "下拉即可重新整理", "s2": "資料已更新", "s3": "目前沒有任何項目"}</think>{"s1":"下拉即可重新整理","s2":"資料已更新","s3":"目前沒有任何項目"}
